 Primary Subject: Football Manager 27 (2026/27 Season / November Launch)
 Key Update: Sports Interactive confirmed 71 playable leagues across 59 men's and 12 women's divisions, featuring newly licensed competitions like the Saudi Pro League and Arkema Première Ligue.
 Status: Confirmed
 Last Verified: October 20, 2026
 Quick Answer: Football Manager 27 features 71 playable leagues spanning 59 men's and 12 women's divisions, including newly licensed additions like the Saudi Pro League and Arkema Première Ligue.
 The hype surrounding Football Manager 27 has reached an all-time high, with improvements to the match engine and the User Interface leaving players eager to get on the pitch. 
 This year's title includes two new fully licensed leagues, the Arkema Première Ligue and the Saudi Pro League, giving managers more options than ever before. 
 In this article, we list all the manageable leagues in Football Manager 27.
 Football Manager 2027 Leagues
 Credit: Sports Interactive Football Manager 2027 features 71 playable leagues, 59 for men's football and 12 for the women's game. 
 Not all of them are fully licensed, but some major ones such as the Premier League, Ligue 1 McDonald’s, and the Bundesliga are. Surprisingly, while the Serie BKT is fully licensed, the Italian Serie A is not
 As mentioned above, the two new leagues, Arkema Première Ligue and the Saudi Pro League, are fully licensed, with managers being able to enjoy the official club logos, kits, and player photos of both competitions. 
 New cup competitions were also introduced for countries such as Chile and Peru, and plenty of leagues were restructured to reflect their new format. 
 Without further ado, here are all the playable leagues in Football Manager 2027, starting with the men's leagues.
